import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from modules import byte_program as bp
# depth checks
for src in ["b'x'", "A[1:2]", "A+B", "A*3", "(A)", "((A))[1:2]", "A[1:2][0:1]", "A[B[1:2]]"]:
    import ast
    t=ast.parse(src, mode='eval')
    print(repr(src), bp.ast_depth(t.body))
ctx = bp.Context([], 'seed')
print(ctx.template('<<random_string>>-<<random_string>>', 'case/0/frame/1/data'))
print(bytes(bp.read_bytes(ctx.template('<<random_string>>-<<random_string>>','case/0/frame/1/data'),0,45)))
import hashlib
print(hashlib.sha256(b'seed/case/0/frame/1/data/0').hexdigest()[:20], hashlib.sha256(b'seed/case/0/frame/1/data/1').hexdigest()[:20])
# errors
for bad in ["A", "1+1", "b'x'*-1", "b'x'[1:2:1]", "b'x'[::2]", "b'x'[-1:]", "True", "None", "f'{1}'", "'a'.encode()", "[1]", "b''[5:1]", "b'x'*9223372036854775808", "x"]:
    try:
        ctx.expression(bad); print(repr(bad), 'ACCEPTED')
    except Exception as e: print(repr(bad), 'rejected:', type(e).__name__, e)
# deep chain of 128 nested subscripts
s = "b'abcdefgh'" + "[0:8]"*64
import ast
print('depth of 64 nested subscripts:', bp.ast_depth(ast.parse(s,mode='eval').body))
print(ctx.expression(s).n)
s2 = "b'abcdefgh'" + "[0:8]"*65
print('depth of 65:', bp.ast_depth(ast.parse(s2,mode='eval').body))
try:
    ctx.expression(s2); print('65 accepted')
except Exception as e: print('65 rejected', e)
